entities.name: Ancient Fang
entities.description: Magical dagger from Innistrad holding memories of everyone who used it; can cut wood, ignite things or kill the undead.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Planeswalker who murdered Drakeston's people with the dagger and gave it to the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Thieving planeswalker from Drakeston who stole the dagger and traveled to Innistrad.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Ravnican cult given the dagger by Sifa.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: Vampire bloodline that became Dack's enemy.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Innistrad's secret guardian who traded knowledge for the dagger.

entities.name: Drakeston
entities.description: Town on Fiora whose people Sifa murdered.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the Cult of Rakdos.

events.summary: Sifa Grent uses the Ancient Fang to murder the people of Drakeston.
events.quote: murdering the people of Drakeston on Fiora

events.summary: Sifa gives the dagger to the Cult of Rakdos.
events.quote: Sifa gave the dagger to the Cult of Rakdos on Ravnica

events.summary: Dack Fayden steals the dagger and learns who was responsible for Drakeston's death.
events.quote: he accidently found out who was responsible for the death of everyone he had known

events.summary: Dack drives Sifa and her undead away but loses her.
events.quote: Dack managed to drive Sifa and her minions away

events.summary: Sorin Markov trades knowledge of Sifa's origins and Dack's life for the dagger.
events.quote: Sorin traded knowledge of Sifa's origins and Dack's life for the dagger.

relations.quote: he lost her before he could exact his revenge
gaining the enmity of the Falkenrath in the process
